name: Dark Conspiracy basics
description: Weapons, armour, gear and enemies for Dark Conspiracy, written for Fudger as a fan aid. Damage is in d6, and Range is the longest range in metres. Dark Conspiracy is a trademark of its owners.

entities.name: Fighting knife
entities.description: Easy to hide under a jacket.

entities.name: Machete
entities.description: Clears brush, and worse.

entities.name: Baseball bat
entities.description: Found in every closet and car boot.

entities.name: Crowbar
entities.description: Also opens doors that should stay shut.

entities.name: Stun baton
entities.description: A charged club. Damage is stun, not wounds.

entities.name: Compact pistol
entities.description: A small concealed-carry handgun.

entities.name: Service pistol
entities.description: The everyday police and military sidearm.

entities.name: Heavy revolver
entities.description: Loud, slow to reload, hits hard.

entities.name: Pump shotgun
entities.description: Brutal up close.

entities.name: Hunting rifle
entities.description: Bolt action, with a scope.

entities.name: Assault rifle
entities.description: Selective fire military rifle.

entities.name: Crossbow
entities.description: Quiet, and a bolt can be fletched with anything.

entities.name: Hand grenade
entities.description: Thrown. Hurts everyone near where it lands.

entities.name: Flare gun
entities.description: Lights up the dark. Sets things alight.

entities.name: Leather jacket
entities.description: Turns a glancing blow.

entities.name: Concealed vest
entities.description: Soft body armour worn under a shirt.

entities.name: Tactical vest
entities.description: Plates front and back. Obvious to anyone who looks.

entities.name: Riot gear
entities.description: Helmet, shield and padding. Slow and hot.

entities.name: Hazmat suit
entities.description: Sealed against gas, spores and fluids.

entities.name: Burner phone
entities.description: Cheap, prepaid, thrown away after one job.

entities.name: Police scanner
entities.description: Listen in on the emergency bands.

entities.name: Night-vision goggles
entities.description: See by starlight. Blinded by sudden bright light.

entities.name: Thermal imager
entities.description: Shows heat through smoke and darkness. Some things show no heat at all.

entities.name: Lock picks
entities.description: For pin locks and padlocks.

entities.name: Laptop
entities.description: With the cell's own encrypted tools.

entities.name: First aid kit
entities.description: Bandages, splints, painkillers and a suture kit.

entities.name: Trauma kit
entities.description: For gunshots and worse. Needs a trained Medic.

entities.name: Heavy torch
entities.description: Bright, and doubles as a club.

entities.name: Climbing gear
entities.description: Rope, harness and hooks.

entities.name: Camera with long lens
entities.description: Proof, if anyone would believe it.

entities.name: Bug detector
entities.description: Finds radio transmitters and hidden cameras.

entities.name: Rosary and holy water
entities.description: Comfort, at least. Maybe more.

entities.name: Corrupted cop
entities.description: A police officer who looks the other way, and reports to something that does not.

Abilities.Traits: Calls for backup at the first sign of trouble.

entities.name: Cult enforcer
entities.description: Muscle for a cult that meets in a basement under the city.

entities.name: Pale stalker
entities.description: A thin grey hunter that moves through ducts and drains and hates light.

Abilities.Traits: Bright light gives it a Bane on every check.

entities.name: Hollow man
entities.description: A body that is still walking after its owner left it.

Abilities.Traits: Feels no pain. Ignores wound effects until its Hits run out.

entities.name: Whisperer
entities.description: Something that rides the minds of others and speaks through them.

Abilities.Traits: Retreats into a host when threatened.

entities.name: Hound from beyond
entities.description: A pack hunter with too many teeth, brought through to track a scent.

Abilities.Traits: Never loses a scent once it has one.
